[ 74 FR 56374 , Oct. 30, 2009, as amended at 75 FR 66464 , Oct. 28, 2010; 78 FR 71958 , Nov. 29, 2013; 79 FR 63788 , Oct. 24, 2014] § 98.178 Definitions. All terms used in this subpart have the same meaning given in the Clean Air Act and subpart A of this part . Subpart R—Lead Production § 98.180 Definition of the source category. The lead production source category consists of primary lead smelters and secondary lead smelters. A primary lead smelter is a facility engaged in the production of lead metal from lead sulfide ore concentrates through the use of pyrometallurgical techniques.
